### Bug type

Behavior bug (incorrect output/state without crash)

### Beta release blocker

No

### Summary

Focused Control UI unit tests on v2026.9.6 load the same pinned Lit runtime through optimized and native module paths, producing Lit's duplicate-version warning even though the assertions pass.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Install the official v2026.9.6 source with Node v24.21.0 and pnpm v12.4.0.
2. Run:
```sh
OPENCLAW_VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=1 node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui.config.ts ui/src/pages/usage/view.test.ts
```
3. Observe the same result with `test/vitest/vitest.ui-isolated.config.ts` and the same test file.

### Expected behavior

The focused UI test should complete without Lit's duplicate-version warning and resolve all Lit imports to one module identity.

### Actual behavior

All 33 assertions pass, but stderr reports: `Multiple versions of Lit loaded. Loading multiple versions is not recommended.` A trace records one optimized `node_modules/.vite/vitest/.../deps/lit-html-*.js` module and one native `node_modules/.pnpm/lit-html@3.3.3/node_modules/lit-html/node/development/lit-html.js` module.

### OpenClaw version

v2026.9.6

### Operating system

macOS ARM64 (Apple Silicon)

### Install method

Official v2026.9.6 source archive with isolated Node v24.21.0

### Model

NOT_ENOUGH_INFO

### Provider / routing chain

NOT_ENOUGH_INFO

### Additional provider/model setup details

NOT_ENOUGH_INFO

### Logs

```shell
RUN  v5.0.0

stderr | ui/src/pages/usage/view.test.ts
Multiple versions of Lit loaded. Loading multiple versions is not recommended.

Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  33 passed (33)

Trace: the optimized `node_modules/.vite/vitest/.../deps/lit-html-*.js` and native `node_modules/.pnpm/lit-html@3.3.3/node_modules/lit-html/node/development/lit-html.js` each register version 3.3.3.
```

### Screenshots, recordings, and evidence

No screenshot required. The module-resolution trace is included in Logs.

### Impact and severity

Affected systems: strict upgrade rehearsals that require warning-free test output. Severity: blocks release acceptance under that policy. Frequency: observed on every focused run using both canonical shared and isolated UI configurations. Consequence: the release rehearsal remains blocked pending a module-resolution fix.

### Additional information

There is one physical `lit@3.3.3` installation: all nested package links resolve to the same pnpm store directory. Disabling the JSDOM dependency optimizer produces one native Lit module load and no duplicate-version warning, but that is not accepted as the canonical test configuration. Candidate areas: `jsdomOptimizedDeps.optimizer.client.include` and Vitest's external module runner.
